engine.name: route 2 — local VieNeu clone (~/.venvs/vieneu) with a local WAV reference
engine.note: Controls listed here are the declared baseline; any control not in supportedControls is an explicit limitation, never silently ignored.

phraseJoinRule: " ".join(phrase.text) must equal voice.proposed.json[key] byte-for-byte; every phrase boundary below falls on a canonical single space. Verified before generation.

benchmark.status: route selected — no pending state remains in this packet
benchmark.selectionAuthority: video-director decision, justified by consistency with the two videos already delivered in this repo that use the identical reference (docs/cuoc-goi-nho-cua-me/voice-ref/, docs/thuong-hay-so-bat-dau-lai/voice-ref/refThanhLong.wav)
benchmark.ownerConfirmationEvidence: owner-notes.md contains two 'hi' notes and no voice instruction; no owner confirmation of any voice exists or is claimed
benchmark.referenceFileFacts: exists; 8.20 s, 24 kHz, mono, pcm_s16le — director-verified. I could not run ffprobe: this runtime has no shell or process-execution tool.
benchmark.previewCatalogueNote: vietnamese-voice-samples/previews/ does not exist on this machine, so no preview slug is cited and scripts/test_voice_catalog could not be run.
benchmark.identity: planningTotal(rate) = SUM(syl/rate) + SUM(pauseAfterSeconds) + SUM(postClipHold) + END hold = SUM(syl/rate) + 2.54 + 10.60 + 3.20 = SUM(syl/rate) + 16.34 s

noVoiceKeyShots: img1 (the deletion, staged inside s5's 1.70 s post-clip hold)
img2 (the umbrella tilt, staged inside s9's 1.30 s post-clip hold)
keyPlan.ownerLineTwoSplit: s2a + a1 + s2b; s2a and s2b are the two verbatim halves of owner line #2 and their join reproduces it byte-for-byte. a1 is an [ADD] connector placed between them so the payoff lands at 7.00 / 7.46 / 7.81 s instead of after second 8.

ending.lastWordNote: s10 is two phrases with a real 0.30 s pauseAfterSeconds BETWEEN them, so its clip end — and the last word of the video — is s10Start + 7/rate + 0.30 + 8/rate = 41.58 / 43.90 / 45.66 s at 4.2 / 3.9 / 3.7 syl/s. start + 15/rate is NOT the last word: it drops the intra-clip gap and would cut BGM 0.30 s before the climax question ends.
ending.audioTailNote: the post-word audio tail is postClipHoldSeconds + silentCardSeconds = 1.80 + 3.20 = 5.00 s; and lastWordEndsAtSeconds + postClipHoldSeconds + silentCardSeconds = 43.90 + 1.80 + 3.20 = 48.90 = benchmark.totalSecondsAt3_9
ending.silentCardElasticRangeNote: this range bounds silentCardSeconds only; stretching it lengthens audioTailSeconds, so script.md section 1 must be recomputed at the measured rate

pauseImplementation: explicit post-synthesis silence during phrase assembly; never inferred from punctuation or ellipsis. pauseBeforeSeconds/pauseAfterSeconds pad inside one clip; minimumPostClipHoldSeconds is a real gap between two clips in the timeline, so every measured clip duration contains speech plus its own clause pauses only.

experimentalCues.note: [cười], [thở dài], [hắng giọng] and similar non-spoken cues remain disabled unless a local benchmark proves the installed engine renders them as intended without leaking into narration or captions.

s1.intent: HOOK + frame-0 cover: name the viewer's role; the on-screen headline must carry the hook with the sound off
s1.emotion: curious, warm, direct, slightly rueful recognition
s1.tempoIntent: hook: brisk on the opening phrase, settle through the middle, hard stop at the end
s1.ending: flat, level — a statement, not a question
s1.postClipHoldPolicy: timeline silence after clip, not punctuation

phrases.text: Mọi người thường tìm đến bạn

s2a.intent: Set up what the viewer already does; the payoff lands on the next key
s2a.tempoIntent: two statements, each landing on its own; the second marginally quicker
s2a.postClipHoldPolicy: the real split gap inside owner line #2 — the payoff a1 lands on this beat

a1.intent: [ADD] THE PAYOFF — stage the effect the previous line only asserted, and plant CP1
a1.tempoIntent: even; the second sentence slightly lower
a1.ending: falling, leaves the floor open for s2b
a1.postClipHoldPolicy: timeline silence after clip — the turn needs air

s2b.intent: Land the last clause of owner line #2
s2b.tempoIntent: even and unhurried — this clause settles after the payoff and must not compete with it
s2b.postClipHoldPolicy: timeline silence after clip, before the turn

phrases.text: Biết làm sao để người khác thấy ổn hơn.
phrases.tempoIntent: even, natural emphasis — no extra weight, no slowing

s3.intent: The turn: alone with the phone
s3.tempoIntent: the hinge: plain opening, slow through the middle so the duration is audible, flat ending
s3.postClipHoldPolicy: withheld-message beat — deliberately BEFORE a2 so the re-hook lands on a beat instead of out of a fade

phrases.text: chính bạn lại ngồi rất lâu trước màn hình điện thoại.

a2.intent: [ADD] Put the room's sound into a story that otherwise has no audible environment
a2.emotion: quiet, close — said as if the narrator had just noticed it, still to one listener
a2.postClipHoldPolicy: timeline silence after clip — the re-hook lands on this beat

s4.intent: RE-HOOK — say the message she cannot send, in her own imagined voice
s4.tempoIntent: slower than a2; the quoted message softer than the narration
s4.ending: falling on the quoted words, no fade
s4.postClipHoldPolicy: timeline silence after clip — the draft is left hanging

s5.intent: Give the verdict on her own small decision
s5.emotion: rueful, close to a shrug, never self-pity
s5.tempoIntent: light first half, settling downward on the second
s5.postClipHoldPolicy: this hold stages img1 — the deletion is seen, never narrated; no voice key exists for it

s6.intent: Correct an assumption the viewer is already making; this call is the actor s10 pays
s6.emotion: gentle, direct, looking at the viewer
s6.tempoIntent: level, then a small lowering on the last phrase
s6.ending: falling, leaves the answer to s7
s6.postClipHoldPolicy: timeline silence after clip — the unanswered call hangs

phrases.text: Không phải vì không có ai

s7.intent: The gut punch — say the true reason she did not send it
s7.emotion: the truest, quietest, least performed line in the video
s7.tempoIntent: slowest real line; the first phrase almost offhand, the second slow with the last two words dropping in volume
s7.ending: stops; the last two words drop in level but never fade to a whisper
s7.postClipHoldPolicy: timeline silence after clip — the recognition lands in it

phrases.text: với việc mình phải là người ổn.

s8.intent: Ask whether anyone is still there — a breath-word, not a stage aside
s8.tempoIntent: short, unhurried; the ellipsis is not performed
s8.postClipHoldPolicy: the longest hold between two voiced clips before the resolution (1.80 s, tied with the closing hold) — timeline silence after clip, never the punctuation

s9.intent: Deliver the umbrella metaphor honestly on the same street as frame 0
s9.tempoIntent: conversational through the first clause, then slow on the reversal so it is audible rather than announced
s9.postClipHoldPolicy: this hold stages img2 — the umbrella's tilt completes with no voice; the owner has already said it in s9

phrases.text: Người thường xuyên che ô cho người khác
cũng có những ngày bị ướt.

s10.intent: The climax — ask the viewer the question nobody asks them; last spoken shot of the video
s10.emotion: warmest and most open, still not loud
s10.tempoIntent: unhurried setup, then the quoted question as ONE clause, ONE breath, no internal pause, at normal volume with a real question contour
s10.ending: rising then held open; the final word falls; no call to action
s10.postClipHoldPolicy: after this clip the voice stops; the END card adds 3.20 s; the post-word audio tail is 5.00 s in total

phrases.text: Và họ cũng cần một người hỏi:
'Hôm nay có chuyện gì với bạn thế?'
phrases.tempoIntent: one clause, one breath, normal volume, question contour — no pause inside

limitations: Reference handling: the pinned reference.source is the synthesis reference and is used UNMODIFIED — it carries no startSeconds/durationSeconds, so gen-voice-clone.py does not crop it. voice-agent must not create a second reference file under a different name: the sidecar is read-only for it, so a new filename would be invisible to the contract and the run would silently use the uncropped audio. If a re-cut is genuinely needed, overwrite this exact path and report it to the director.

The reference is a director decision (route 2, Thanh Long), justified by consistency with two videos already delivered in this repo that use the same file. It is NOT an owner confirmation: owner-notes.md holds only two 'hi' notes. vietnamese-voice-samples/previews/ does not exist on this machine, so no preview catalogue is cited and scripts/test_voice_catalog could not be run.

The VieNeu clone supports only seed, denoise, local reference and silence padding. rate, pitch, volume, speed, atempo and style are unavailable and are requested nowhere in this file; all pacing and intensity direction is read by the voice-agent from phrase intent, not from the engine.
All non-spoken cues stay disabled: no [cười], no [thở dài], no [hắng giọng] and no actingCue field anywhere.

Silence is real: pauseBeforeSeconds/pauseAfterSeconds pad inside one clip, and minimumPostClipHoldSeconds is a gap between two clips in the timeline. No beat is ever created with punctuation. img1, img2 and END have no voice key and carry no speech.
Phrases are joined with exactly one space (phraseJoin). An assembler joining with an empty string would merge two words and fail the CER gate.
Naturalness, intimacy and emotional delivery are not verifiable from this file or from ASR; only the voice-agent's measured clip data and the user's optional listen can confirm them.

The 3.9 syl/s planning rate is a planning figure, not a measurement: 4.1 syl/s is this repo's planning convention (docs/motion-design-lab/script.md:23) and the measured Thanh-Long runs in this repo are lower (docs/xay-doi-minh-hay-chung-minh/voice-report.md:24 = 3.75 syl/s; docs/lam-lai-.../audio-review.md:12 = 3.5-3.7), so the plan already sits at the measured rate and the intimate register is carried by holds, emphasis and light rather than by slowing the voice down.

The 3.9 syl/s figure is an assumption pending measurement of this video's own clips. Measured clips decide the final timeline; the plan stays inside 45-55 s for any rate between 3.29 and 4.43 syl/s, and script.md section 5 gives the elasticity order in both directions.
